```{r setup, include=FALSE,echo=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)   
library(lubridate)   
library(janitor)     
library(knitr)       
library(scales)
library(leaflet)
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
data3 = read.csv("../data/train.csv")
head(data3)
max(data3[,10])


```



```{r}
ui <- page_sidebar(
  title = "AirBnB : New York",
  sidebar = sidebar(
    card(
      card_header("Price"),
      sliderInput(
        "price",
        "Set value",
        min = 0,
        max = 10000,
        value = c(0,10000)
      ),
    ),
    card(
      card_header("Minimum of mean review"),
      sliderInput(
        "review",
        "Set value",
        min = 0,
        max = 5,
        value = 0
      ),
    )
  ),
  card(leafletOutput("map"))

)


# Define server logic ----
server <- function(input, output) {

dataFiltred=reactive({subset(data3,data3[,10]>input$price[1] &
                data3[,10]<input$price[2] &
                data3[,14]>input$review)
})




  
output$map <- renderLeaflet({
  
  df=dataFiltred()
  
  long=c(df[,8])
  lati=c(df[,7])
  name=c(df[,2])
  
  leaflet(options=leafletOptions(
  minZoom = 10,
  maxZoom = 18,
  dragging = TRUE
)) %>%
  
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron")%>%
  setView(lng = -74, lat = 40.7, zoom = 11)%>%
  setMaxBounds(
    lng1 = -73.7,
    lat1 = 40.92,
    lng2 = -74.3,
    lat2 = 40.4
  )%>%
  addMarkers(lng=long,lat = lati,popup = name,clusterOptions=markerClusterOptions(
showCoverageOnHover = TRUE,
zoomToBoundsOnClick = TRUE,
spiderfyOnMaxZoom = TRUE,
removeOutsideVisibleBounds = TRUE,
freezeAtZoom = FALSE
) )
  })
}

# Run the app ----
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```


```{r}
ggplot(data3, mapping = aes(x = data3[,14], y = data3[,16]))+geom_point()
```
